what_differs: The 2026-07-08 onsite stated that postback events (URLs, click IDs) from WagerTech's server-to-server pilot must be stored against the Sign-Up. No WAGR issue mentions postbacks in summary, description or comments, and the routing question (backend first or direct to Salesforce) was never answered later.
suggested_action: Suggestion only: create a parked ticket (Holding Pen WAGR-443 or Phase 2 WAGR-478) for postback ingestion that records the open routing question (L0869), and confirm the phase with WagerTech. Jumpr's internal 2026-07-13 view (L0956, tier2) was 'probably after go-live' but no client agreement is recorded.
